rows.name: Shells, Sub-shells (s, p, d, f) & Aufbau Principle

missing.text: An orbital is the area in which electron moves within a shell. One or more orbitals in the electron shell of an atom with the same energy level are called sub-shells. A shell or energy level is divided into sub-shells or sub-energy levels. The 'n' value of a shell is placed before the symbol for a sub-shell.
